note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Windows PowerShell 5.1 on CON-SRV02. The DHCP test network (Private switch MGLab-DHCPTest and the DHCPTest NICs) is built by the episode setup script on the host and removed again in teardown.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $s2 { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep04 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

screens.name: dns
commands: Invoke-NetLabDnsDeployment -DefinitionPath .\network.json | Format-Table Server, Action, Target, Result -AutoSize
Invoke-NetLabDnsDeployment -DefinitionPath .\network.json | Format-Table Server, Action, Target, Result -AutoSize

screens.name: dhcp
commands: Invoke-NetLabDhcpDeployment -DefinitionPath .\network.json | Format-Table Server, Action, Target, Result -AutoSize
Get-DhcpServerv4Failover -ComputerName CON-SRV01 | Format-List Name, PartnerServer, Mode, LoadBalancePercent, State, ScopeId
Get-DhcpServerv4Failover -ComputerName CON-SRV02 | Format-List Name, PartnerServer, Mode, LoadBalancePercent, State, ScopeId

screens.name: lease
commands: Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-CLI01 { ipconfig /renew DHCPTest | Out-Null; ipconfig /all }

screens.name: failover-drift
commands: Get-DhcpServerv4Reservation -ComputerName CON-SRV01 -ScopeId 172.16.50.0 | Format-Table IPAddress, ClientId, Name
Get-DhcpServerv4Reservation -ComputerName CON-SRV02 -ScopeId 172.16.50.0 | Format-Table IPAddress, ClientId, Name
Get-DhcpServerv4Reservation -ComputerName CON-SRV02 -ScopeId 172.16.50.0 | Format-Table IPAddress, ClientId, Name

screens.name: report
prepare: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { if (-not (Get-DnsServerResourceRecord -ZoneName lab.contoso.com -Name camera01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Add-DnsServerResourceRecordA -ZoneName lab.contoso.com -Name camera01 -IPv4Address 172.16.50.30 } }

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { Remove-DnsServerResourceRecord -ComputerName CON-DC01 -ZoneName lab.contoso.com -Name camera01 -RRType A -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-DhcpServerv4Failover -ComputerName CON-SRV01 -Name CON-SRV01-CON-SRV02 -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-DhcpServerInDC -DnsName con-srv01.lab.contoso.com -IPAddress 10.50.0.21 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-DhcpServerInDC -DnsName con-srv02.lab.contoso.com -IPAddress 10.50.0.22 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
foreach ($vm in 'CON-SRV01', 'CON-SRV02') { Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred { Uninstall-WindowsFeature DHCP -IncludeManagementTools | Out-Null } }
